tbesh_html:
1) direction, counsel, guidance, good advice, (wise) counsel
1a) direction, guidance
1b) counsel
1b1) good or wise counsel
1b2) of the wicked

strongs_1890.strongs_def: (only in plural) properly, steerage (as a management of ropes), i.e. (figuratively) guidance or (by implication) a plan
strongs_1890.derivation: or תַּחְבּוּלָה; from H2254 (חָבַל) as denominative from H2256 (חֶבֶל);
